body:
Migrate lib/models.mjs off models retiring November 30, 2026 (gemini-3.8-flash-*, gemini-4-argon-*, gemini-pro-orchestrator-argon, gpt-oss-120b-medium, claude-4-6), move gemini-4-hydrogen-* to the gemini-flash fast sub-pool, promote Neon defaults, preserve Enterprise 3.7/3.6/3.1 pass-through, and fix selectCliEffortFlag for Orchestrator.

Objectives:
1. Update MODELS, MODEL_ALIASES, ORCHESTRATOR_MODELS, FRONTIER_NO_ORCHESTRATOR, TIER_CANDIDATES, PROSECUTORS, PROSECUTOR_CANDIDATES, ARL_LENS_MODELS, ROLE_MODELS, and RETIRED_MODEL_MAP in lib/models.mjs.
2. Export sameFamilyProsecutorsFor(builderModel) for distinct fresh-context Gemini fallback when Claude quota is unavailable.
3. Fix selectCliEffortFlag in lib/models.mjs to return null for ORCHESTRATOR_MODELS and support unsuffixed dynamic-effort base slugs (gemini-4-neon, gemini-4-hydrogen).
4. Update lib/doctor-models.mjs comments and test/models-live-catalog.test.mjs, test/models-registry.test.mjs, test/agy-json-schema.test.mjs.

Acceptance criteria:
1. All catalog, alias, retirement, Enterprise pass-through, and selectCliEffortFlag tests pass. Verify: node --test test/models-live-catalog.test.mjs test/models-registry.test.mjs test/agy-json-schema.test.mjs
title: Migrate model catalog to Hydrogen/Neon/Claude-5.5 and fix Orchestrator --effort flag
